name: Feature request

## Problem

What are you trying to do that Ergon makes hard or impossible today? Describe
the problem before the solution.

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see. If it touches the data layer or an API, note the
expected impact on **both** the SDK and the Studio (they move together).

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches, and why they fall short.

## Additional context

Links, prior art, or examples.
